黄麻: jute (Corchorus capsularis Linn.)；plant fiber used for rope or sacks
黄鼠狼给鸡拜年: Beware of suspicious folk bearing gifts, they are sure to be ill-intentioned. (idiom)
黄鼠狼给鸡拜年，没安好心: see 黃鼠狼給雞拜年|黄鼠狼给鸡拜年[huang2 shu3 lang2 gei3 ji1 bai4 nian2]
黄龙: see 黃龍縣|黄龙县[Huang2 long2 Xian4]
黄龙县: Huanglong, a county in Yan'an City 延安市[Yan2 an1 Shi4], Shaanxi
